data.long_description:
Standing as an iconic landmark against the Dubai skyline, 1/JBR is a towering symbol of luxury, marking the entrance to the prestigious Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR). This magnificent 43-story tower offers opulent apartments that promise an unparalleled living experience. With its prime location, distinguished address, and meticulously designed interiors, 1/JBR is set to redefine exclusive beachside living in the heart of JBR, Dubai.

Key Features & Highlights:

-4 Bedrooms Plus Maid’s Room
-Unit Size: 3,753.48 Sq. Ft
-Direct Beach Access
-Palm & Panoramic Dubai Eye and Sea Views
-Vacant
-Unfurnished 
-Expansive Balcony
-Luxurious Furnishings
-Renovated Property
-Unique
-Chiller Empower
-Electric Cooker & Stove
-2 Free Parking Spots
-Guest Parking
-5% Security Deposit
-2,130 AED - DEWA Deposit (for 1st time residence in Dubai)
-EJARI 220 AED

Chic, private, and meticulously designed, the apartments are adorned with unique features, designer fittings, and custom glass facades. Spacious sundecks offer breathtaking panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Palm Jumeirah, creating an idyllic retreat for its residents.

The communal spaces—lobby, swimming pool, and gym—reflect the highest standards of cutting-edge design, while semi-private lifts, private lobbies, and VIP parking services further elevate the exclusivity of this prestigious residential tower.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
